summary: Elbit Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing a ~$260 million contract award to supply PULS rocket artillery systems and munitions to a European NATO member country, performed over five years. No price per share, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; this is an ordinary defense contract announcement, not a special situation. The disclosure is a foreign private issuer current report (US equivalent of a Form 8-K), signed by Corporate Secretary Pinchas Confino Adi. Risk-arb angle: none; watch execution and backlog conversion into revenue.
